title: State child welfare disaster plan activation notice
description: A notice that a state child welfare agency has activated its disaster plan: the counties, the plan elements (identify and locate children, continue services, respond to new cases, stay in contact with displaced staff), the lead and the reporting schedule. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

elements.description: The plan elements and the first action for each

examples: Identify children in care in the area
Pull placement list for the two counties

examples.element: Identify children in care in the area
examples.action: Pull placement list for the two counties

reporting.description: When the agency reports to the state and to federal partners
examples: Status to the state at 08:00 and 16:00 daily until all children are located.
